question: Where is the National War Memorial located?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Delhi**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **National War Memorial** is located in **Delhi**, India.
 
• It is a monument built to honor and remember the soldiers of the Indian Armed Forces who have made the supreme sacrifice in the line of duty post-independence.
 
• The memorial is spread over 40 acres and is situated near India Gate, another prominent war memorial in Delhi.
 
• It was **inaugurated by Prime Minister Narendra Modi **on **25th February 2019**.
 
• The design of the National War Memorial includes four concentric circles: the "**Amar Chakra**" (Circle of Immortality), the "**Veerta Chakra**" (Circle of Bravery), the "**Tyag Chakra**" (Circle of Sacrifice), and the "**Rakshak Chakra**" (Circle of Protection).

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **National War Memorial** also includes **a central obelisk, an eternal flame, and six bronze murals** depicting famous battles fought by the Indian Army, Navy, and Air Force.
 
• The memorial is open to the public, and it serves as a place for citizens to pay their respects to the fallen soldiers.
 
• Special ceremonies are held on national days like Republic Day and Independence Day to honor the sacrifices of the armed forces.
 
• The memorial also serves an educational purpose, providing visitors with information about the history and valor of the Indian Armed Forces.
